entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
I need to return a VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I just need the process, not a long conversation.
Of course, I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could I please have your order number?
It's VF-8675309. Look, I know it's been over a month. We had a family emergency. My husband had to have unexpected surgery and was in the hospital for weeks. I'm just getting to this now.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is okay now. Let me just pull up that order for you... one moment please.
Okay, I see it here. The order was delivered on December 15th, which was 43 days ago.
It's no problem at all. According to our policy, you have 10 days from the delivery date to make a return. You're unfortunately outside that window.
Oh. 10 days? I thought it was much shorter. Well, that's a relief. So, what do I do?

I've already processed the return authorization for you. I'm sending the email with the prepaid shipping label to the address on file right now. You should see it in your inbox within the next five minutes. Just print it, attach it to the box, and drop it off.
Perfect. That was surprisingly efficient. Thanks, Diana.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
